latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Quickly generate Bangla captioned videos from your video clips or text.

- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB for automatic Bangla subtitles or voiceover.
- Establishes secure backend sessions using NEMO_TOKEN or an anonymous token for 7-day free access.
- Provides fast cloud video rendering (30–90 seconds typical), with 1080p MP4 export.
- Handles user prompts for uploading, video editing, subtitle generation, file export, and credit checking.
- Automatically manages cloud session, error handling, and summarizes timeline edits for a smooth user experience.
